findings: Only a small minority of bowls have documented archaeological contexts; most surfaced in private collections or the antiquities market.
The chapter distinguishes verified or documented excavation sites from places reported in museum registers or by dealers whose provenance cannot presently be verified.
The highlighted Iraq site list provides an authority-building seed set, including alternate ancient and modern place names.
Susa is identified as the controlled-excavation case for western Iran in this discussion; other western Iranian findspot reports are described as unverified.
BM 91711's Arban attribution is described as plausible but unverified because the museum register attributes it to Layard while his account and prospectus do not document the bowl.
